title: (fix) O3-6019: Preserve medication dosage drafts when switching modes
body:
## Requirements

See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [x] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Switching medication dosage modes now preserves structured and free-text entries independently while the form remains open. Inactive dosage details are hidden, and saving includes only the selected dosage representation. Free-text orders exclude the inactive structured fields, including frequency.

Successful saves close the workspace without resetting individual fields. Failed saves retain the draft for retry.

## Screenshots

### Before

Switching between structured and free-text dosage clears the entries in each mode, forcing the prescriber to re-enter them.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4df444a6-ee6d-43af-8633-cd0530ab9d0b

### After

Switching between structured and free-text dosage restores the entries in each mode and hides inactive dosage details. Saving adds only the selected free-text dosage to the order basket.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/746423ef-faf8-48df-93b5-a03161829e44

A simulated HTTP 503 interrupts a medication revision save. The entered dosage, prescription, dispensing, and indication values remain available, and Save stays enabled for retry.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/53d264fe-0ae0-4084-a248-9e430f8ccbe6
